title: Question 2
hint: Give a short sentence (3–7 words). Say how they reacted: They erupted in applause.

ja.prompt: 観客は何をしましたか？
ja.hint: 3〜7語の短い文で答えてください。反応を言う：They erupted in applause。

local.hint: Give a short sentence (3–7 words). Say how they reacted: They erupted in applause.

zh.hint: 用3到7個詞的短句回答。說明他們的反應：觀眾爆發出掌聲。

title: Question 3
prompt: What happened when the award was announced?
hint: Describe the concrete event (6–10 words): mention the audience reaction after the announcement.
sample: The audience erupted in applause when it was announced.

ja.prompt: 賞が発表されたとき、何が起こりましたか？
ja.hint: 6〜10語で具体的な出来事を答えてください。発表後の観客の反応を述べましょう。
ja.sample: 司会者が発表すると、会場は拍手喝采に包まれた。
